messages.text: Hi, I returned the garden hose reel. I think my neighbour bought the same one from you. Can you tell me who else bought it, and if they returned theirs?

I can only discuss your own orders, so I can’t identify other customers or say whether they returned theirs. I can see that the garden hose reel in your order was received back. Would you like to request a refund for it?

messages.text: Could you share my neighbour’s name or email, so I can ask whether she returned hers? And yes, I’d like a refund for my returned hose reel.
